customrecordtype.description: Rep-to-phone-number assignments for Click-to-Call. Managed exclusively by the Setup Wizard SPA's Phones & reps section. Hidden from admin UI via allowuiaccess=F; edit only via the wizard. Runtime reads remain open so the softphone Suitelet can resolve a rep's caller ID per call.

customrecordcustomfield.label: Employee
customrecordcustomfield.description: Sales rep this phone-number assignment belongs to.

customrecordcustomfield.label: Twilio Phone Number SID
customrecordcustomfield.description: Twilio internal ID for the phone number (starts with PN). Pulled from GET /Accounts/{AccountSid}/IncomingPhoneNumbers.json.

customrecordcustomfield.label: Phone Number
customrecordcustomfield.description: E.164 phone number (e.g., +15551234567). The rep's outbound caller ID for calls placed via this assignment.

customrecordcustomfield.label: Label
customrecordcustomfield.description: Admin-friendly label for the number (e.g., "Main Sales Line"). Optional. CLOBTEXT (FREEFORMTEXT not supported by SDF validation on this customrecordtype — matches the pattern used across CTC custom records).

customrecordcustomfield.label: Primary Caller ID
customrecordcustomfield.description: If checked, the softphone uses this assignment as the rep's outbound caller ID by default when they have multiple assignments.
